src.title: 3 Mayonesas sin una gota de aceite (3 oil-free mayos)

recipes.title: Classic Oil-Free Mayo (Egg & Yogurt) – Mayonesa sin aceite
steps: Put the eggs, yogurt, mustard, lemon juice, salt, pepper and garlic (if using) in a tall jug.
Blend with an immersion blender until thick and completely smooth.
Transfer to a clean jar and refrigerate.
recipes.notes: Translated from Spanish (Cocina para Foráneos, Ecuador: '3 mayonesas sin una gota de aceite'). Ingredients and amounts are the ones he says in the video; salt and pepper are to taste. As the creator says in the comments, without oil it's really a creamy yogurt-and-egg sauce in the style of mayonnaise. It keeps about 3 days in the fridge; extra lemon or a splash of vinegar helps it last a little longer. Macros are estimates per 2 tbsp.

recipes.title: Green Avocado Mayo – Mayonesa verde sin aceite
steps: Put the avocado, yogurt, mustard, cilantro, lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper in a tall jug.
Blend with an immersion blender until smooth and bright green.
Transfer to a jar, press plastic wrap onto the surface and refrigerate. Best within 2–3 days; the lemon slows browning but it will still darken.
recipes.notes: Translated from Spanish (Cocina para Foráneos, Ecuador: '3 mayonesas sin una gota de aceite'). Ingredients and amounts are the ones he says in the video; salt and pepper are to taste. As the creator says in the comments, without oil it's really a creamy yogurt-and-egg sauce in the style of mayonnaise. It keeps about 3 days in the fridge; extra lemon or a splash of vinegar helps it last a little longer. Macros are estimates per 2 tbsp. In the video the green version is shown with onion rings for dipping.

recipes.title: Spicy Orange Mayo – Mayonesa naranja picante sin aceite
steps: Put the eggs, yogurt, mustard, garlic and sriracha in a tall jug.
Blend with an immersion blender until smooth and orange.
Transfer to a jar and refrigerate. A commenter's tip the creator liked: blend in a roasted red pepper.
